expected.report:
(A) rectosigmoid polyp 8 mm

(A)  Sections show a polypoid piece of large intestinal mucosa featuring tubular crypts with high grade dysplasia, showing cribriform and back-to-back glands, loss of polarity with full-thickness nuclear stratification and markedly enlarged nuclei with prominent nucleoli. There is no evidence of invasive malignancy. Margins are involved.

(A) RECTOSIGMOID, rectosigmoid polyp 8 mm, polypectomy - TUBULAR ADENOMA with HIGH GRADE DYSPLASIA.
